title: Pokemon TCG Scoop Up Cyclone 128/131 Prismatic Evolutions ACE SPEC Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokemon TCG Scoop Up Cyclone 128/131 Prismatic Evolutions ACE SPEC Rare card is a highly sought-after collectible card from the Pokemon Trading Card Game. This Trainer-Item card features the character Scoop Up Cyclone and is part of the Prismatic Evolutions set. As a rare card, it is a valuable addition to any Pokemon TCG collection, especially for fans of the ACE SPEC series. With its unique design and abilities, this card is a must-have for collectors and players alike.
